description: Audit Service Commission - Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Audit Service
categorisation: This gazette contains the Service Minute for the Sri Lanka State Audit Service, detailing public service recruitment, grades, salary scales, and service conditions. It falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it specifically addresses public sector service administration, including post classifications, salary structures, and service regulations for government audit personnel, without involving government structural changes, individual appointments with portfolios, or other specialized categories.
